title: Dino Run and NFT
tagline: A simple game where you help Dino jump to avoid obstacle and earn NFT
description: A simple game where you help Dino jump to avoid obstacles and earn NFT. Players can mint their NFT after the game. Players can save their scores to their NFT. Players can login to the game with their Unstoppable Domains. Players can donate stream tokens to support the game. There will be more features.
how_its_made: The game is built with Javascipt and kaboom.js. Unstoppable Domain was used to allow players to login to the game. Tableland SDK was used to store the gamers scores.  NFTPort API was used to mint NFTs. Superfluid was used to allow players to stream asset to support the game. The game is upload to Valist.  https://app.valist.io/roycoolweb/dino-run-and-nft
